faq_heading: Eagle Ridge condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Eagle Ridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Eagle Ridge, Coquitlam: 10 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 30%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 10 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Eagle Ridge rose from 5 in June to 10 in October (+100.0%), and 10 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.3% of Coquitlam’s 779 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Eagle Ridge?
Eagle Ridge also had 4 houses listed and 4 sold in October, against 10 condos and townhomes listed. The Eagle Ridge houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Eagle Ridge home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 townhomes sold in Eagle Ridge with a median price of $873,250 (the middle half sold between $838,750 and $1,029,250), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 98.2% of the last list price; 36% sold above list. They had a median $535 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median strata fee of $471 a month. 4 condos sold in Eagle Ridge, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 condos and townhomes listed in Eagle Ridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Eagle Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Eagle Ridge had a sales ratio of 30%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Eagle Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 10 condos and townhomes sold in Eagle Ridge over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Eagle Ridge sell for?
faq.a: 14 townhomes sold in Eagle Ridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $873,250.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.2% of the last list price (36% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
